sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) unreadCount FROM tbl_notifications WHERE tenantId=:tenantId AND userId=:userId AND status='unread' AND channel='in_app'

SELECT n.id,n.notificationType,n.title,n.message,n.status,n.workflowId,n.taskId,n.createdDate,CASE WHEN n.notificationType='chat_message' THEN '/dashboard?chat=open' WHEN n.taskId IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/tasks/edit?id=',n.taskId) WHEN n.workflowId IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('/workflows/view?id=',n.workflowId) ELSE '/dashboard' END targetUrl FROM tbl_notifications n WHERE n.tenantId=:tenantId AND n.userId=:userId AND n.channel='in_app' AND (n.status='unread' OR (n.status='read' AND n.readDate>DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,INTERVAL 24 HOUR))) ORDER BY n.createdDate DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT 10
